content: .{@-चर@} {%a.%} (-रा, -री|{%f.%}) moving about by night, night stalker. . ({@-रः@}) .²1 a fiend, goblin, an evil spirit; तस्मै निशाचरैश्वर्यं प्रतिशुश्राव राघवः <ls>R. 12. 69</ls>. .²2 an epithet of Śiva. .²3 a jackal. .²4 an owl. .²5 a snake. .²6 the ruddy goose. .²7 a thief. ({@-री@}) .²1 a female fiend. .²2 a woman going to meet her lover at night by appointment; राममन्मथशरेण ताडिता दुःसहेन हृदये निशाचरी <ls>R. 11. 20</ls> (where the word is used in sense 1 also). .²3 a harlot.
